title: Integrative structural analysis of NF45-NF90 heterodimers reveals architectural rearrangements and oligomerization on binding dsRNA.
authors: Winterbourne, Sophie; Jayachandran, Uma; Zou, Juan; Rappsilber, Juri; Granneman, Sander; Cook, Atlanta G
one_liner_zh: 该文研究NF45-NF90异二聚体结合dsRNA的结构重组与寡聚化，虽用机器学习与结构建模，但对象为蛋白-RNA互作而非蛋白-DNA，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Complexes of nuclear factors 45 and 90 (NF45-NF90) play a multitude of roles in co- and post-transcriptional RNA processing, including regulating adenosine-to-inosine editing, cassette exon and back splicing, and splicing fidelity. NF45-NF90 complexes recognize double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) and, in human cells, primarily interact with Alu inverted repeats (AluIRs) that are commonly inserted into introns and other non-coding RNA regions. Intronic AluIRs of  approximately 300 bp can regulate splicing outcomes, such as generation of circular RNAs. We examined domain reorganization of NF45-NF90 domains on dsRNAs exceeding 50 bp to gain insight into its RNA recognition properties on longer dsRNAs. Using a combination of phylogenetic analysis, solution methods (including small angle X-ray scattering and quantitative cross-linking mass spectrometry), machine learning, and negative stain electron microscopy, we generated a model of NF45-NF90 complex formation on dsRNA. Our data reveal that different interactions of NF45-NF90 complexes allow these proteins to coat long stretches of dsRNA. This property of the NF45-NF90 complex has important implications for how long, nuclear dsRNAs are recognized in the nucleus and how this might promote (co)-regulation of specific RNA splicing and editing events that shape the mammalian transcriptome.
abstract_zh: 核因子45和90（NF45-NF90）复合物在共转录和转录后RNA加工中发挥多种作用，包括调控腺苷到肌苷编辑、盒式外显子和反向剪接，以及剪接保真度。NF45-NF90复合物识别双链RNA（dsRNA），在人类细胞中主要与通常插入内含子和其他非编码RNA区域的Alu反向重复序列（AluIRs）相互作用。约300 bp的内含子AluIRs可调控剪接结果，如环状RNA的产生。我们研究了NF45-NF90结构域在超过50 bp的dsRNA上的结构重组，以深入了解其在较长dsRNA上的RNA识别特性。通过结合系统发育分析、溶液方法（包括小角X射线散射和定量交联质谱）、机器学习和负染色电子显微镜，我们生成了NF45-NF90复合物在dsRNA上形成的模型。我们的数据揭示，NF45-NF90复合物的不同相互作用使这些蛋白质能够包被长段dsRNA。NF45-NF90复合物的这一特性对于理解长核dsRNA在细胞核中如何被识别，以及这可能如何促进特定RNA剪接和编辑事件的（共）调控以塑造哺乳动物转录组具有重要意义。
